limitations: These explicit joint what-if assumptions are neither calibrated estimates, probabilities nor proven economic bounds. Base is a named scenario and does not mean most likely.

MSFT 2026 original 6d702db7b014494aa5c352f5bd9034cffcff003052c6379f0e82ed65775deb9b does not establish full nonoperating asset, current debt, noncontrolling, preferred, convertible, other-class or award inventory. Unknowns remain unknown; scenario amounts never become observations.

Nonoperating asset hypotheses exclude cash and operating assets. Current debt hypotheses exclude noncurrent debt, finance leases and separately hypothesized additional convertible claims. The original discloses current long-term debt of 9.227 billion; all declared total-current-debt hypotheses exceed this partial component.

Unresolved PSU conditions/maxima, stock-award compensation allocation, pending ESPP and deferred units are covered only by hypothetical incremental award shares. Authorization pools are not outstanding awards; no complete inventory or exact treasury-stock dilution is claimed.
